example_summary: This example calculates the taxable income for Pingu Trading Pvt. Ltd. by adjusting book profits for survey-detected stock differences, statutory disallowances for political ads and TDS defaults, and applying the 100% deduction for specified warehousing business under Section 35AD.
source_provision:
### Statutory Summary Matrix: PGBP Adjustments & Direct Tax Rules

| Area / Head | Statutory Section / Rule | Operative Threshold / Condition | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stock Survey** | Section 133A | Survey revealing unrecorded stocks or omitted sales | Added directly to business income / PGBP |
| **Rented Premises Repairs** | Section 30(a)(i) / Section 37 | Tenant incurring repairs without contractual obligation | Allowable u/s 37 if required for efficient business operations |
| **Political Advertisements** | Section 37(2B) | Advertisement in souvenirs of political parties | Strictly disallowed as business expenditure |
| **TDS Non-Deduction** | Section 40(a)(ia) | Specified payments made without tax deduction at source | 30% of such sum disallowed under PGBP |
| **Excessive Payments** | Section 40A(2) | Payments to related parties exceeding fair market value | Excess amount over fair market value disallowed |
| **Specified Business** | Section 35AD | Capital expenditure on specified businesses like warehousing | 100% deduction of capital expenditure allowed |
| **Specified Business Loss** | Section 73A | Loss from specified business u/s 35AD | Can be set off and carried forward only against specified business income |

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Section 35AD Deduction: Capital expenditure incurred on specified businesses qualifies for a 100% deduction, and any resulting loss can be carried forward exclusively under Section 73A.

> [!WARNING]
> Section 40(a)(ia) Disallowance: Failure to deduct tax at source on resident payments results in a statutory disallowance of 30% of the expenditure.

director.justification: The problem requires a comprehensive reconciliation of book profit to taxable income by adjusting for survey findings, specific disallowances, and section 35AD deductions.
director.visual_metaphor: A balancing scale where the starting net profit is adjusted by adding back disallowed expenses and subtracting tax-deductible capital investments.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish the starting net profit and the impact of the survey findings.
Reconcile business income by adjusting for non-allowable expenses and specific disallowances.
Apply the specific deduction for capital expenditure on warehousing.
Handle the loss from specified business and carry forward rules.
Summarize the final taxable income calculation.

beats.voice_sync_text: നമ്മുടെ കഥയിലെ protagonist Pingu Trading Pvt. Ltd. ആണ്. അവരുടെ Net profit 33,90,000 രൂപയാണ്. എന്നാൽ 31.03.2026-ൽ നടന്ന Section 133A survey-ൽ ചില കാര്യങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തി. ഇതിന്റെ ഫലമായി 3,75,000 രൂപ business income-ലേക്ക് add ചെയ്യേണ്ടി വന്നു.
beats.director_goal: Establish the starting net profit and the impact of the survey findings.

beats.voice_sync_text: അടുത്തതായി disallowances നോക്കാം. Section 37(2B) പ്രകാരം political party-യുടെ souvenir-ൽ നൽകിയ advertisement-ന്റെ 2,500 രൂപ disallowed ആണ്. Director-ന്റെ ഭാര്യക്ക് നൽകിയ തുകയിൽ fair market value-ക്ക് മുകളിലുള്ള 75,000 രൂപ Section 40A(2) പ്രകാരം disallow ചെയ്തു. കൂടാതെ TDS deduct ചെയ്യാത്തതിനാൽ interest-ന്റെ 30% അതായത് 24,000 രൂപ Section 40(a)(ia) പ്രകാരം add back ചെയ്തു.
beats.director_goal: Reconcile business income by adjusting for non-allowable expenses and specific disallowances.

beats.voice_sync_text: Pingu Trading ഒരു agricultural warehouse നിർമ്മിക്കാൻ 25,00,000 രൂപ invest ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. Section 35AD പ്രകാരം ഇങ്ങനെയുള്ള specified business-ന് 100% deduction ലഭിക്കും.
beats.director_goal: Apply the specific deduction for capital expenditure on warehousing.

beats.voice_sync_text: ഈ warehousing business-ൽ നിന്നുള്ള income 15,00,000 രൂപയാണ്. എന്നാൽ 25,00,000 രൂപ deduction ഉള്ളതിനാൽ 10,00,000 രൂപയുടെ Specified business loss ഉണ്ടാകുന്നു. Section 73A പ്രകാരം ഈ നഷ്ടം മറ്റ് business income-മായി set off ചെയ്യാൻ കഴിയില്ല, ഇത് carry forward മാത്രമേ ചെയ്യാൻ പറ്റൂ.
beats.director_goal: Handle the loss from specified business and carry forward rules.

beats.voice_sync_text: അവസാനമായി, business income-നോടൊപ്പം interest on refund കൂടി ചേർത്ത് Gross Total Income കണ്ടെത്താം. ഇതിൽ നിന്നും Section 80GGB പ്രകാരം political party-ക്കും Electoral Trust-നും നൽകിയ 1,02,500 രൂപ കുറച്ചാൽ നമുക്ക് 23,60,370 രൂപ Total Income ആയി ലഭിക്കും.
beats.director_goal: Summarize the final taxable income calculation.
